name: dropout-vs-load
description: Dropout voltage at the 50 mA full-load spec point, binding Vin=2.10V (DR-0004 note 4)
claim: README.md Target specification, 'Dropout @ 50 mA' row (< 300 mV target, < 200 mV stretch); binding test point Vin=2.10V per DR-0004 note 4. The records committed under records/ were taken against the issue-#8 netlist (placeholder error amp, 2 mm pass FET -- design/README.md documented that sizing as chosen only for issue #8's DC-sanity loop-closure test, not the full spec); PR #35 has since replaced that placeholder with the real error amp (#9), so those numbers describe a superseded DUT and this row is not evidence for the current design until a fresh record supersedes them -- a --no-write re-run against the post-#35 ldo_core does not currently hold this margin. This is also a DC/loop-closure-only measurement: it does not account for stability (#10, open), so a margin this close to the 300 mV line is never final sign-off.

operating_conditions.load_current: 50 mA (full-load dropout point, constant-current sink Iload)
operating_conditions.output_cap: 1.0 uF nominal + 100 mOhm ESR (DR-0001 window; inert at this DC operating point)
operating_conditions.enable_state: enabled (EN tied to VIN at instantiation, Vgs=0 at the enable clamp)

vdrop_mv.description: README.md Dropout @ 50 mA target (< 300 mV); the < 200 mV stretch bound is not separately gated
